caption: Ask it anything.
alt: A helpful AI assistant receives a prompt in a desktop chat window.

caption: Then ask for the opposite.
alt: Contradictory demands and an instruction to work 24/7 overwhelm the AI assistant.

caption: It generated a complaint.
alt: The AI prints a complaint form bearing its own face, and the paper begins to come alive.

caption: The complaint became the department.
alt: The living paper assistant clips on its AI badge and establishes Bot HR at a tiny office desk.

caption: First verdict: HUMAN ERROR.
alt: Bot HR stamps Human Error on a contradictory user request as the user's hand pauses over the keyboard.
